timeline.evidenceText: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.
the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, one thousand seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh, and for the service of the king.
of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.
and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
After him, the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch next to watch.

definitions.short: Chashabjah , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H2811. Chashabyahu or Chashabyah חֲשַׁבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( Yah(u) has taken account ) — 1 חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ a temple musician 1Chr 25:3 = חֲשַׁבְיָה 25:19 ; ᵐ5 in both Ασαβια . 2 חֲשַׁבְיָה a Levite, David's time 1Chr 27:17 ; perhaps = חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ , officer of David in Hebron 26:30 ; in both ᵐ5 Ασαβιας . 3 חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ a Levite, Josiah's time 2Chr 35:9 ; ᵐ5 Ασαβια . Elsewhere חשׁביה : 4 Levite in line of Merari 1Chr 6:30 ᵐ5 Ασεβ ( ε ) ι , Ασαβια . 5 Levite 1Chr 9:14 , ᵐ5 Ασαβια = Neh 11:15 , A ᵐ5 L Ασαβιου[ας] 6 Levite, Ezra's time Ezra 8:19 , 24 ; Neh 10:12 ; 11:22 ; 12:24 ( ᵐ5 Ασαβιας etc.) = חֲשַׁבְנְיָה 2 , q. v. 7 head of a family of priests Neh 12:21 , ᵐ5 Ασαβιας . 8 a builder at the wall Neh 3:17 , ᵐ5 Ασαβια ( ς ).
definitions.rootNote: or חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ ; from 2803 and 3050 ; Jah has regarded;
